audit.why: 56.45% over 4496 games; FAVOURED at 4/10 is right. Lissandra's point-and-click R and 450-range W punish an all-in assassin whose only entrances are Shuriken Flip (16s at rank 1) and Perfect Execution.
audit.corrected: Difficulty kept; prose sharpened to name the real entrances.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers on rows 0-3: phases[0..3].side read 'Lissandra' (7/10, 7/10, 8/10, 8/10) while win[0..3] and the packet levelChart both read 'Skill'.
audit.why: Akali has no dash until level 3 and Lissandra has no lock until 6, so the early rows are genuinely neutral — the packet and content layer are right and the full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0..3].side to Skill at 5/10 as one atomic group and rewrote each why to match; win[0..3] already read Skill so no cross-layer disagreement is introduced. Rows 4-6 already agree on Lissandra and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Perfect Execution's recast is an execute (a HP threshold, not a damage race), and Assassin's Mark gives her an empowered auto-attack that opens the combo — the wind-up, not a cast, is the tell. Twilight Shroud's unselectability was described vaguely with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Riot text: R re-cast 'executing all enemies she strikes'; P empowers her next attack with bonus range; W makes her 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' on a 20/19/18/17/16 cooldown.
audit.corrected: Execute threshold written into dontsFull[2].d and enemyWin, the auto-attack tell into dosFull[1].d, and the real Shroud/Flip cooldowns into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Twilight Shroud 20/19/18/17/16, Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Perfect Execution 120/90/60.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ten fields called Akali he/his; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood and tradeBad pasted verbatim under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed; both bled bullets rewritten to match their titles.

notes: Rows 0-3 of the level chart were a cross-layer disagreement (full said Lissandra, content and packet said Skill); resolved toward the packet as one atomic group with matching why rewrites.
